name: The Council Assembled stacks Atherann's Acuity on Taldaram's Torment ticks (#12547)
contract: The Council Assembled 504103: 'Taldaram's Torment now increases the damage of your next Valanar's Vengeance or Keleseth's
Calamity by $504105s1% per tick for $504105d, stacking $504105u times.' Atherann's Acuity 504105 is a self aura
(SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER +3% on Valanar's Vengeance/Keleseth's Calamity, StackAmount 5), but no effect of 504103
casts it and nothing else did, so the stacking damage bonus never appeared (#12547). Each Torment tick must add one
stack: two ticks give two stacks with the talent, and none without it. The stacks modify the damage of
Valanar's Vengeance 572795 (family 26, flags 262144, inside the aura's class mask) by 2 x 3% = 6%.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
